pairs.target: tiāngāngliàng , tǎ wéi jiù chī wán le zhōu .
pairs.english: Tavi had finished his porridge as soon as day broke.
pairs.hanzi: 天刚亮，塔维就吃完了粥。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu dài liànxí yòng de tiě jiàn , zhī dài zhǐ , bǐ hé yíkuài diàn zài zhǐ xià de báo mùbǎn .
pairs.english: He brought none of the iron pieces used for practice; he carried only paper, a pen and a thin wooden board to place beneath the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有带练习用的铁件，只带纸、笔和一块垫在纸下的薄木板。

pairs.target: gěi sè lā de duǎnxìn zuówǎn yǐjīng tóuchūqù , shuō jīnrì gēn lǎoshī rènshi de shīfu qù běibiān zuò bànrì jìlù , huílái zài xiě jiànwén .
pairs.english: His short letter to Sela was already posted last night, saying today he would go north with a craftworker known to his teachers, do half a day of recording, and write what he saw on returning.
pairs.hanzi: 给瑟拉的短信昨晚已经投出去，说今日跟老师认识的师傅去北边做半日记录，回来再写见闻。

pairs.target: nà fēngxìn dāngrán búhuì gǎn zài tā chūmén zhīqián dào jiā , tā háishì juéde yīngdāng xiān xiě .
pairs.english: Of course that letter would not reach home before he left, but he still felt he ought to write first.
pairs.hanzi: 那封信当然不会赶在他出门之前到家，他还是觉得应当先写。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài ménfáng wài děng tā , jiàn tā tí zhe xiǎobāo , xiān wèn chī guò méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Nerai waited outside the gatehouse for him, and seeing him carrying his small bag, first asked whether he had eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在门房外等他，见他提着小包，先问吃过没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō chī le liǎngwǎn , tā biàn jiào tā bǎ bùzi fàngmàn xiē , bié gāng chūmén jiù pǎo de dùzǐténg .
pairs.english: Tavi said he'd had two bowls, so she told him to slow his steps, instead of running himself into a stomachache just after leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说吃了两碗，她便叫他把步子放慢些，别刚出门就跑得肚子疼。

pairs.target: yú shīfu zài běimén páng gēn liǎnggè bānggōng zhàn zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Master Yu was standing together with two helpers beside the north gate.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅在北门旁跟两个帮工站在一起。

pairs.target: xīn de biāo bǎn yòng mábù guǒ zhe , chángchángde yìtiáo , xiàng yǒurén bǎ yíshàn zhǎimén chāixiàlái kángzǒu le .
pairs.english: The new scale board was wrapped in sackcloth, a long strip, as though someone had taken down a narrow door and shouldered it away.
pairs.hanzi: 新的标板用麻布裹着，长长的一条，像有人把一扇窄门拆下来扛走了。

pairs.target: yígè niánqīng bānggōng kànjiàn tǎ wéi , wèn shìbushì yòu duō gèrén lái cuī tāmen kuài xiē .
pairs.english: A young helper saw Tavi and asked whether another person had come to urge them to hurry.
pairs.hanzi: 一个年轻帮工看见塔维，问是不是又多个人来催他们快些。

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō búshì , lái jì tāmen jiūjìng yǒu duō màn .
pairs.english: Master Yu said no: he'd come to record just how slow they were.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说不是，来记他们究竟有多慢。

pairs.target: nà rén xiào zhe bǎ bǎnzi huàn dào lìngyìbiān jiānshàng , gěi tǎ wéi ràngchū wèizhì , què méi jiào tā dāshǒu .
pairs.english: Laughing, the man shifted the board to his other shoulder, making room for Tavi, but did not ask him to help.
pairs.hanzi: 那人笑着把板子换到另一边肩上，给塔维让出位置，却没叫他搭手。

pairs.target: chū le běimén , lù réng jiā zài yìpái ǎiwū zhījiān .
pairs.english: Outside the north gate, the road was still hemmed in between a row of low houses.
pairs.hanzi: 出了北门，路仍夹在一排矮屋之间。

pairs.target: shíbǎn hái pū zhe , liǎngbiān yǒu càiqí , yě yǒu yìjiān zhèng wǎng wài pō xǐcài shuǐ de xiǎo fànpù .
pairs.english: The paving stones still continued, with vegetable beds on both sides and a small eating shop that was currently throwing vegetable-washing water outside.
pairs.hanzi: 石板还铺着，两边有菜畦，也有一间正往外泼洗菜水的小饭铺。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù shānjǐ lùchū yíxiàn chénguāng , jìnchù què quán shì rén de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Far away a sliver of morning light showed over the ridge, but close by there was nothing but human noise.
pairs.hanzi: 远处山脊露出一线晨光，近处却全是人的声音。

pairs.target: nài lěi zǒu dào yíkuài jiù lù bēi páng tíngxià , bǎ tú yā zài xī shàng , héduì chàkǒu xīn qì de shí biān .
pairs.english: Nerai walked to an old road marker and stopped beside it, pressed the map against her knee and checked the newly laid stone edge at the fork.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾走到一块旧路碑旁停下，把图压在膝上，核对岔口新砌的石边。

pairs.target: yú shīfu méiyǒu děng tā chāo wán , gé zhe lù shuō tāmen xiān dào qúkǒu , nài lěi dāying hòu , tǎ wéi cái gēnzhe zǒu .
pairs.english: Master Yu did not wait for her to finish copying; across the road she said they would go ahead to the inlet, and after Nerai agreed, only then did Tavi follow.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅没有等她抄完，隔着路说他们先到渠口，奈蕾答应后，塔维才跟着走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn zhè liǎngjùhuà , cái fàngxīn bǎ jiǎo cóng bēi biān nuókāi .
pairs.english: Only after hearing those two exchanges did Tavi feel easy about moving his feet away from the marker.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见这两句话，才放心把脚从碑边挪开。

pairs.target: zài xiàngxià zǒu , shuǐshēng jiànjiàn gài guò le jiēshàng de xiǎngdòng .
pairs.english: As they went farther down, the sound of water gradually drowned out the noises of the street.
pairs.hanzi: 再向下走，水声渐渐盖过了街上的响动。

pairs.target: qúkǒu héng zài liǎngdào shíqiáng zhījiān , yìbiān de shuǐ shùn cháng cáo liúzǒu , lìngyìbiān tiēzhe zhábǎn fān qǐ báimò .
pairs.english: The inlet lay between two stone walls; on one side water ran away along a long channel, on the other it foamed white against the sluice board.
pairs.hanzi: 渠口横在两道石墙之间，一边的水顺长槽流走，另一边贴着闸板翻起白沫。

pairs.target: píngtái shàng duī zhe sāngè kōng kuāng , yǒurén zhèng cóng kuāng dǐ jiǎn luòxià de càiyè .
pairs.english: Three empty baskets stood on the platform; someone was picking fallen vegetable leaves from the bottoms.
pairs.hanzi: 平台上堆着三个空筐，有人正从筐底拣落下的菜叶。

pairs.target: bānggōng jiào nà rén ràng yi ràng , nà rén shuō chuán hái méi lái , kuāng bùnéng tuīxiàqù .
pairs.english: A helper asked the man to move aside; the man said the boat had not come yet and the baskets couldn't be pushed down.
pairs.hanzi: 帮工叫那人让一让，那人说船还没来，筐不能推下去。

pairs.target: yú shīfu bǎ mùxiá fàngzài lùbiān , xiān wèn chuán zài nǎér děng .
pairs.english: Master Yu put the case by the road and first asked where the boat was waiting.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅把木匣放在路边，先问船在哪儿等。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén cháo xiàyóu gè zhǐ le yígè fāngxiàng , yòu hùxiāng dèng le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: The two each pointed in a different direction downstream, then glared at one another.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人朝下游各指了一个方向，又互相瞪了一眼。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng qiángbiān kào , gěi tái bǎn de rén liú dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi edged toward the wall to leave room for the people carrying the board.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往墙边靠，给抬板的人留地方。

pairs.target: niánqīng bānggōng shuō zìjǐ bù zhīdào nǎtiáo chuán , zhǐ zhīdào shǒubì yǐjīng má le .
pairs.english: The young helper said he didn't know which boat, only that his arm was already numb.
pairs.hanzi: 年轻帮工说自己不知道哪条船，只知道手臂已经麻了。

pairs.target: yú shīfu biàn ràng tāmen xiān luò bǎn , diàn zài gān chù , zìjǐ qù zhǎo kàn zhá de rén .
pairs.english: So Master Yu had them lower the board first, support it on a dry spot, and herself went to find the sluice keeper.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅便让他们先落板，垫在干处，自己去找看闸的人。

pairs.target: tā huílái shí , shēnbiān duō le gè yāojiān guà yàoshi de lǎorén .
pairs.english: When she returned, an old man with keys hanging at his waist was beside her.
pairs.hanzi: 她回来时，身边多了个腰间挂钥匙的老人。

pairs.target: lǎorén jiào tāmen bǎ kuāng kào dào lìngyímiàn qiáng , téng píngtái , dàn bùxǔ dǔzhù xiàwǔ sòngcài de rén .
pairs.english: The old man told them to move the baskets against the other wall and clear the platform, but not obstruct the people bringing vegetables that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 老人叫他们把筐靠到另一面墙，腾平台，但不许堵住下午送菜的人。

pairs.target: " jīntiān zhǐ huàn zhèkuài bǎn . "
pairs.english: “We're only replacing this board today.”
pairs.hanzi: “今天只换这块板。”

pairs.target: yú shīfu shuō , lǎorén què cháo tā yáoshǒu , shuō zhèhuà liú zhe gēn xiàwǔ de rén shuō .
pairs.english: Master Yu said this, but the old man waved at her, saying to save those words to tell the afternoon people.
pairs.hanzi: 虞师傅说，老人却朝她摇手，说这话留着跟下午的人说。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén zài zhēng , liǎnggè bānggōng bǎ bǎn tái shàng píngtái , tǎ wéi děng yú shīfu zhāoshǒu cái guòqù .
pairs.english: Nobody argued further; the two helpers lifted the board onto the platform, and Tavi waited for Master Yu to beckon before going over.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人再争，两个帮工把板抬上平台，塔维等虞师傅招手才过去。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā zhàn zài shuōhǎo de qiáng cè , xiān kànyíbiàn jiù bǎn , bù máng zhe dòngbǐ .
pairs.english: She had him stand on the agreed wall side, first looking over the old board once instead of rushing to write.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他站在说好的墙侧，先看一遍旧板，不忙着动笔。

pairs.target: jiù bǎn liè de hěn cháng , biānjiǎo bèi shuǐjìn de fāhēi , jǐhángzì jǐ zài bùtóng yánsè de qī xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: The old board had cracked for a long stretch; its edges had blackened from soaking in water, and several lines of writing crowded beneath paint of different colours.
pairs.hanzi: 旧板裂得很长，边角被水浸得发黑，几行字挤在不同颜色的漆下面。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi zhàozhe chāo bìng bùnán , zǒujìn cái fāxiàn , yídào lièfèng zhènghǎo chuānguò zuì xiàmiàn de shùzì .
pairs.english: Tavi had thought copying it would not be hard, but on approaching he discovered a crack ran right through the lowest number.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为照着抄并不难，走近才发现，一道裂缝正好穿过最下面的数字。

pairs.target: zuǒ bànbiān xiàng sān , yòu bànbiān de mùtou què yǐjīng diào le .
pairs.english: The left half looked like a three, but the wood on the right half had already fallen away.
pairs.hanzi: 左半边像三，右半边的木头却已经掉了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ zhǐ pū hǎo , bǐjiān xuán zài shàngmiàn , méi gǎn tì nà bàngè shùzì bǎ zuìhòu yì wān tiān chūlái .
pairs.english: He laid out the paper, the pen tip hovering above it, not daring to supply the final curve for that half-number.
pairs.hanzi: 他把纸铺好，笔尖悬在上面，没敢替那半个数字把最后一弯添出来。
